_comment: ngsolve linear_elasticity#3 (MatrixValued(..., symmetric=True) stores only the upper triangle). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604 in both 2D (unit_square maxh 0.3) and 3D (unit_cube maxh 0.5) on H1 order 1: full is exactly d^2 times the scalar DOF count (76 = 4*19, 234 = 9*26) and symmetric is exactly d(d+1)/2 times it (57 = 3*19, 156 = 6*26), so the packing claim is arithmetic. The consequence is then exercised: a deliberately non-symmetric tensor with skew-part norm 1.22 comes back from the symmetric space with a skew part of exactly 0.0 -- the space cannot hold it -- while the full space reproduces the same tensor to 2.3e-16. On a genuinely symmetric field the two spaces agree exactly, so the saving costs nothing when the field really is symmetric. Mutation: setting symmetric=False for the sym space makes the DOF counts equal and the fixture fails on 2d_sym_is_half_d_dplus1_times_scalar.
